pub fn my_charges(ctx: &ViewContext) -> Vec<MyCharge> {
    ctx.db
        .charge()
        .attendee()
        .filter(viewed(ctx))
        .filter(|c| c.status != PROPOSED)
        .map(|c| {
            let incident = ctx.db.incident().id().find(c.incident_id);
            MyCharge {
                id: c.id,
                incident_id: c.incident_id,
                incident_kind: incident.as_ref().map(|i| i.kind.as_str().to_string()).unwrap_or_default(),
                zone_name: incident.as_ref().and_then(|i| ctx.db.zone().id().find(i.zone_id)).map(|z| z.name).unwrap_or_default(),
                happened_at: incident.as_ref().map(|i| i.opened_at).unwrap_or(c.created_at),
                amount_cents: c.amount_cents,
                status: c.status.clone(),
                why: why_words(ctx, &c),
                clause: clause_words(ctx, &c),
                dispute_text: c.dispute_text.clone(),
                paid_at: c.paid_at,
            }
        })
        .collect()
}

pub fn my_claims(ctx: &ViewContext) -> Vec<MyClaim> {
    let me = viewed(ctx);
    ctx.db
        .claim()
        .routed_to()
        .filter(Identity::ZERO..)
        .filter(|c| c.claimant == Some(me))
        .map(|c| MyClaim {
            id: c.id,
            incident_kind: c.incident_kind,
            zone_name: c.zone_name,
            status: c.status,
            status_note: c.status_note,
            payout_cents: c.payout_cents,
            payout_reference: c.payout_reference,
            opened_at: c.opened_at,
            settled_at: c.settled_at,
            incident_id: c.incident_id,
            statement: c.statement,
        })
        .collect()
}

pub fn my_visits(ctx: &ViewContext) -> Vec<MyVisit> {
    ctx.db
        .visit()
        .attendee()
        .filter(viewed(ctx))
        .map(|v| MyVisit {
            zone_visit_id: v.zone_visit_id,
            zone_id: v.zone_id,
            zone_name: zone_name(ctx, v.zone_id),
            // Only the booth the band stood at; a stay known only by its zone names none.
            booths: ctx.db.booth().id().find(v.booth_id).map(|b| b.name).into_iter().collect(),
            started_at: v.started_at,
            ended_at: v.ended_at,
            minutes: v.minutes,
        })
        .collect()
}

pub fn board_attendees(ctx: &ViewContext) -> Vec<AttendeeOut> {
    if !is_staff(ctx) {
        return Vec::new();
    }
    ctx.db
        .attendee()
        .person_id()
        .filter(0u64..)
        .map(|a| AttendeeOut {
            node_id: a.node_id,
            band_id: ctx
                .db
                .band_owner()
                .owner()
                .find(a.identity)
                .map(|o| o.band_id.into())
                .or_else(|| ctx.db.crowd_member().identity().find(a.identity).map(|m| m.band_id))
                .unwrap_or(0),
            findable: a.findable,
            crowd: a.crowd,
            organization: ctx.db.organization().id().find(a.organization_id).map(|o| o.name).unwrap_or_default(),
            handles: ctx
                .db
                .social_handle()
                .owner()
                .filter(a.identity)
                .map(|h| crate::social::views::HandleOut { platform: h.platform, handle: h.handle })
                .collect(),
            role: attendee_role(ctx, &a),
            display_name: a.display_name,
            created_at: a.created_at,
        })
        .collect()
}

pub fn board_photos(ctx: &ViewContext) -> Vec<BoardPhoto> {
    if !is_staff(ctx) {
        return Vec::new();
    }
    ctx.db
        .photo()
        .zone_id()
        .filter(0u64..)
        .map(|p| BoardPhoto {
            node_ids: ctx
                .db
                .photo_tag()
                .photo_id()
                .filter(p.id)
                .filter_map(|t| ctx.db.attendee().identity().find(t.attendee).filter(|a| a.findable).map(|a| a.node_id))
                .collect(),
            zone_name: ctx.db.zone().id().find(p.zone_id).map(|z| z.name).unwrap_or_default(),
            id: p.id,
            url: p.url,
            taken_at: p.taken_at,
            caption: p.caption,
            people_count: p.people_count,
            read: p.features_call_id != 0,
        })
        .collect()
}

    ctx.db
        .people_link()
        .from_id()
        .filter(0u64..)

            id: l.id,
            kind: l.kind,
            from_kind: l.from_kind,
            from_id: l.from_id,
            to_kind: l.to_kind,
            to_id: l.to_id,
            weight: l.weight,
        })
        .collect()
}
